about: Русский оверлей L2Solo (C4): launcher/l2hub/l2solo_ru.js, включается "botLanguage": "ru" в profiles/c4.json. speech — фразы каталога BotSpeechTemplates (английский оригинал → перевод), say — строки вне каталога (регулярка по всему тексту чата → перевод, $1… — группы), fragments — перевод подставляемых групп, llm — замены в промптах и указание языка для модели. Docs — docs/L2SOLO.md, «Язык и болтовня ботов».

llm.directive: L2Hub language rule (overrides any earlier language instruction): every chat text a player will see (replies, say, shout, party, clan and trade lines, the reply field) must be in Russian, written in Cyrillic: casual, natural Russian the way people chat in Lineage 2 (short; game slang like пати, кач, бафы, хил, сосы, спот, ГК, РБ, лут, шмот is fine). The player may write Russian in Latin transliteration (for example "privet, kak dela" or "pojdem kachatsya"): understand it as Russian and answer in Russian. Keep exactly as given, in Latin letters: character names, clan names, item names, NPC and place names, chat commands (.buff, accept, sell ... for ... Adena), JSON keys, enum values and tool arguments. Text that is not a chat message (titles, clan names, shop titles, store messages) stays in English with Latin letters only: the game client cannot show Cyrillic there.
